name: RigMoveSchedulePlanner
tagline: Plan every rig move between pads – readiness gates, move steps, duration vs plan and schedule conflicts in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete rig move planning app for oil & gas drilling teams: one lane per rig across pads, move steps with planned and logged hours (rig down, move loads, rig up, pre-spud), critical readiness gates (location, permit, water, route) that block the release, forecast vs plan, conflict checks for rigs and pads, and an 8-week lookahead. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Demo mode with 27 fictional moves for 7 rigs
Readiness gate matrix with critical gates and forecast dates
Move steps with planned vs logged hours and forecast finish
Rig schedule lanes with drilling time and today line
Conflict checks: same rig, same pad, broken rig chain
Workflow Planned → Ready → Rigging down → In transit → Rigging up → Complete with rules
Bulk status changes, delete and undo, CSV export
Phone layout with bottom view bar and gate chips
